questionText: Which of the following is/are Bottom-Up Parser(s)?
explanation:
Step 1: Classification of Parsers
Parsers are broadly categorized into Top-Down parsers and Bottom-Up parsers.

Step 2: Top-Down Parsers
Top-Down parsers construct the parse tree from the root (top) down to the leaves. Examples include:
- Predictive Parser
- LL(1) Parser
- Recursive Descent Parser

Step 3: Bottom-Up Parsers
Bottom-Up parsers construct the parse tree starting from the leaves (bottom) up to the root by attempting to reduce the input string to the start symbol. Examples include:
- Shift-reduce Parser
- LR Parser (SLR, CLR, LALR)

Therefore, the correct options representing Bottom-Up parsers are (A) Shift-reduce Parser and (D) LR Parser.
